name: Spatial Data Strategy and Governance
seo_title: Geospatial Data Strategy and Governance | Spatial Intelligence
title: Who owns the data? Which version is authoritative?
intro: When several departments produce spatial layers without a single point of reference, effort is duplicated and the numbers conflict. We build with you a strategy that sets priorities, and a governance framework that defines who owns each dataset, who updates it, and who can access it.
card: A roadmap that ties your data to your organization's goals, and a framework that defines ownership, roles, and access.
fit: More than one department produces or uses spatial data.
You are planning investments in platforms or AI and want a clear foundation.
You need to align your data with national requirements and standards.
steps: We assess the state of your data, current maturity, and usage gaps.
We run workshops with the departments involved.
We define the core data, its owners, the roles, and the access policies.
We design the roadmap, initiatives, and success indicators.
We present the strategy and framework to leadership for approval.
